title: 1.2 Branches of Physics
description: Branches of Physics concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A device uses a magnetic field to convert mechanical motion into an electric current. Which branch explains the conversion?
A student says optics and electromagnetism are unrelated. Which fact from the branch descriptions is the best reply?
options: Electromagnetism includes light among its phenomena
Optics and electromagnetism use the same instruments
questions.correctAnswer: Electromagnetism includes light among its phenomena

questions.question: A medical team uses an ultrasonic scan and an x-ray image. Which pair of branches supplies the principles?
A car engine converts chemical energy into motion and also warms its surroundings. Which branches describe these processes?
A researcher moves from modeling a falling rock to modeling an electron. Which change in branch is occurring?
options: Quantum mechanics to acoustics in nature
Optics to thermodynamics in the textbook

questions.question: Which scenario requires both mechanics and acoustics?
options: Analyzing a vibrating string that moves a loudspeaker cone
Analyzing the reflection of light in a mirror for students
Analyzing the decay of a radioactive atom now for students
Analyzing the heat flow in a metal bar now in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Analyzing a vibrating string that moves a loudspeaker cone

questions.question: Which scenario requires both thermodynamics and electromagnetism?
options: Studying heat produced by an electric current in a wire
Studying the pitch of a bell in physics in the textbook
Studying the orbit of a planet in class in the textbook
Studying the image in a concave lens now in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Studying heat produced by an electric current in a wire

questions.question: A physicist investigates the structure of an atomic nucleus and then the motion of a galaxy. Which pair of branches is involved?
options: Acoustics and optics in the unit
Optics and acoustics in the unit

questions.question: Which claim about the branches of physics matches the textbook table?
options: Mechanics can be divided into quantum and classical branches
Optics is a branch of acoustics for students in the textbook
Thermodynamics studies only atomic nuclei now in experiments
Electromagnetism has no connection to light now for students
questions.correctAnswer: Mechanics can be divided into quantum and classical branches

questions.question: A designer chooses materials for a concert hall to improve sound quality and also plans its lighting. Which branches apply?
A student groups optics, acoustics and mechanics together. Which shared feature justifies the grouping?
options: Each is a branch of physics
questions.correctAnswer: Each is a branch of physics

questions.question: A satellite carries a camera and a radio transmitter. Which branches underlie these two functions?
A scientist studies a swinging pendulum and then the sound it makes on impact. Which branches are used in sequence?
A physicist investigates how light bends and how a magnet deflects a beam of electrons. Which branches are used?
Which example best illustrates classical rather than quantum mechanics?
options: Predicting the flight path of a thrown ball
Modeling an electron in an atom in the unit
Explaining atomic spectra now in this topic
questions.correctAnswer: Predicting the flight path of a thrown ball

questions.question: Which example best illustrates quantum rather than classical mechanics?
options: Describing the behavior of electrons in an atom
Calculating the braking distance of a car still
Finding the trajectory of a rocket for students
Measuring the speed of a train now for students
questions.correctAnswer: Describing the behavior of electrons in an atom

questions.question: A laboratory studies heat transfer and another studies sound production. Which two branches are represented?
Which branch description is accurate?
options: Thermodynamics studies thermal energy and its transfer now
Acoustics studies the structure of nuclei now for students
Optics studies the motion of planets still in the textbook
Nuclear physics studies the reflection of light in physics
questions.correctAnswer: Thermodynamics studies thermal energy and its transfer now

questions.question: A machine uses gears to lift a load and a coating to reduce friction. Which branch best covers both concerns?
A physicist works on the properties of light and also on astronomical observations. Which pair of branches fits?
